name: American University of Sharjah
englishBachelors: All programmes, on an American model: architecture and design, arts and sciences, business, engineering.
note: An American-style university on a large purpose-built campus, with students from around ninety countries. Known for architecture and design; merit scholarships include the Sheikh Khalifa Scholarships, and fees are not given here.

programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.about: A five-year degree with a shared design foundation year, a liberal arts base and on-the-job professional training.
programmes.ib: Needs maths and a science subject, at least grade B equivalent, within the last three school years; no IB grade conversion is published.
programmes.selectionNote: Applicants submit a portfolio. 24 IB points is a guideline; the offer level can be higher and depends on seats.

flagshipSource.title: AUS Bachelor of Architecture: five-year degree with foundation year

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering
programmes.about: A four-year, 130-credit degree in supply chain and logistics, and quality and maintenance engineering, after general education in maths and science.
programmes.ib: Engineering majors need maths and physics at grade B or equivalent; physics by Grade 11. No IB grade conversion is published.
programmes.selectionNote: 24 IB points is a guideline; the offer level can be higher depending on major and seats.

flagshipSource.title: AUS BS in Industrial Engineering: four-year, 130-credit programme

summary: American-style university in Sharjah with about 30 bachelor's degrees in architecture and design, arts and sciences, business and engineering, taught in English.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma, six subjects (not Islamic Education), three at HL, 24 points as a guideline; may be higher by major. Certificate: six subjects, 4+ each, 29 points total.

dates.label: President's and Chancellor's Scholarship applications close
Period Three, the last regular period, closes

faculties.name: College of Architecture, Art and Design
faculties.line: Architecture, interior design, design management, graphic design and film and new media design. Portfolio for some majors.

faculties.name: College of Arts and Sciences
faculties.line: Economics, English, international studies, media, psychology, mathematics, physics, biology, chemistry and data science.

faculties.name: College of Engineering
faculties.line: Chemical, civil, computer, electrical, industrial and mechanical engineering, plus computer science. Maths and physics at grade B.

faculties.name: School of Business Administration
faculties.line: Accounting, economics, finance, management, marketing, supply chain and information systems. Maths at grade B.

notes: Offers are decided by period, not rolling: apply early, as seats and preferred majors fill. Late applicants (21 May-24 June 2027) are only considered if seats remain.
AUS publishes no single Fall 2027 closing date; the last regular period ends 20 May 2027, and early file completion is 5 July 2027. Dates are tentative.
English: TOEFL iBT 80, TOEFL ITP 550 or IELTS Academic 6.5. An English Bridge Program exists (AED 36,012 per semester). Also needs a personal statement and two school recommendations.
Documents must be attested for enrolment; UAE Ministry of Education Certificate of Equivalency is required of most applicants. Application fee AED 400 plus 5% VAT.
Tuition for 2026-27 is AED 110,876 a year for all majors, plus lab fees of AED 1,552-1,700 per course; Fall 2027 fees are not yet published.

President's Scholarship (non-UAE schooling): 100% tuition, 40 IB points needed. Chancellor's (UAE schooling): 38 points. Merit scholarships cover 10-20% for 95%+ averages. Total new-student aid is capped at 55%.
Residence fees on the page are for 2025-26: AED 7,000-15,000 a semester, with a 25% first-year discount.
